decisions.source_zh_cn: 代理理事长团队战　长距离代表
decisions.note: This is an internal team-race representative label rather than a standard real-world race name. The pinned repository does not establish a stable Vietnamese/canonical form for the full label, so defer instead of guessing from Chinese.
JRA's official English race programme uses Queen Elizabeth II Cup for エリザベス女王杯; use the official race name rather than a Chinese calque.

decisions.source_zh_cn: 优骏牝马（日本橡树大赛）
decisions.note: JRA's official English programme uses Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks); preserve the established race name and its parenthetical Oaks designation.
Horse Racing in Japan/JRA schedule materials use Shinetsu Stakes for 信越ステークス.

ja: ルミエールオータムダッシュ
decisions.note: The source race maps to ルミエールオータムダッシュ in public Uma Musume race data, and JRA materials use the English heading Lumiere Autumn Dash.
Horse Racing in Japan's official NAR schedule uses Zen-Nippon Nisai Yushun for 全日本2歳優駿; normalize the Chinese source to that established race name.
JRA race-card materials give the English heading Rokko Stakes for 六甲ステークス.

JRA uses Kyodo News Hai (Tokinominoru Kinen) as the official English race name. The assigned source is the base 共同通信杯 label, so lock the corresponding base name Kyodo News Hai without inventing a Chinese semantic translation.
Horse Racing in Japan materials use Kanto Oaks for the NAR race 関東オークス.
JRA's graded-race schedule uses Sekiya Kinen for 関屋記念.
JRA race-card and Horse Racing in Japan materials use Kanetsu Stakes for 関越ステークス.

ja: チャンピオンズカップ
decisions.note: JRA's official English programme uses Champions Cup for チャンピオンズカップ.
Public Uma Musume race data maps the source to フェニックス賞, and established Japanese racing references use Phoenix Sho.
JRA race-card materials give the English heading Hosu Stakes for 鳳雛ステークス.
JRA/Horse Racing in Japan materials use the established international name Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe for 凱旋門賞.
JRA's graded-race materials use Hakodate Nisai Stakes for 函館2歳ステークス; normalize the localized Chinese source to the established race name.

ja: 函館スプリントステークス
decisions.note: JRA's graded-race schedule uses Hakodate Sprint Stakes for 函館スプリントステークス.
JRA's graded-race schedule uses Hakodate Kinen for 函館記念.
Public Uma Musume race data maps the source to ひいらぎ賞, while JRA English materials use Hiiragi Sho. Preserve that proper race name rather than translating the Chinese plant term.
JRA's official channel and established race references use Wasurenagusa Sho for 忘れな草賞.
